<subject>Re: Lumière Santé, Henriette Meunier</subject>
<body>
Bernard,  
We completed a review this morning to try and identify missing data on patient admission patterns, surgery schedules, and equipment usage for Henriette but haven’t found anything yet. Do you know of any relevant data that could help us in this effort? Thanks,  
Eugène Leconte  
</body>
<quoted>
----- Original Message ----- 
From:  Adrien Thibault  
To: Bernard Schmitt 
Cc: Édouard Pruvost ; Aimé Ruiz ; Honoré Allard 
Sent: Wednesday, 08 January 2025 18:20  
Subject: Lumière Santé, Henriette Meunier

Bernard,  
Below is a summary of Medisoft’s work on the Henriette patient database to date. The "Inter_Regional Medinet" file shows the connections and patient flow between units in our model and "Expand_France_Data_011000.xls" details the current ward information compiled so far. Total bed capacity closely matches reported capacity as shown in "Beds_Report_0110.xls". Reported Henriette total in 1997 is 860 beds and in the Medisoft database it is 840 beds through 1997.  

Lyon  
	
	EMSS database

			Difference
		
Henriette total

We are currently working on developing hourly patient admission profiles, seasonal surgery scheduling, and collecting equipment usage data. Bernard, we will try to contact you tomorrow (Thursday — Lyon or Wednesday — Marseille) to answer any questions you may have on this information.  
Sincerely,  
Eugène Leconte  
</quoted>
